title: Eternal Nights Project X Hub
features:
Free Revive – It allows you to relive for free without losing progress.

No Clip – It crosses walls and objects of the map.

Run Speed – Activates change in running speed.

Speed Value – Slider to adjust the speed value.

Infinite Stamina – It removes the consumption of stamina while running.

Keep Inventory – You keep your items even after you die.

Anti Jumpscare – Block jumpscares from the animatronics.

Flashlight – It completely illuminates the map, removing the darkness.

Infinite Battery – Infinite battery for the flashlight.

Animatronic Eye Light – It highlights the eyes of animatronics for better identification.

Animatronic ESP – Shows the location of the animatronics on the map.

Toy ESP – It highlights interactive toys.

Item ESP – Displays the position of collectible items.

Coin ESP – Show coins on the map.

Chest ESP – Highlights available trunks.
